note: A SNAPSHOT, not a live index: it is keyed by ratchet id and goes stale the moment an entry retires.
It is deliberately not gated. A gate would force `pnpm run generate-fmt-corpus` plus a full verify on every PR that retires an fmt entry, which costs more than the drift it would catch.
`regions` holds one cluster label per differing region, in file order, under the rule stated in KNOWN-FAILURES.md.
Derived from the diff-ALIGNED hunks of compatibility/fmt/{oracle,actual}. The doc rule is applied POSITIONALLY to the report line pair; the two agree on the first label for 517 of 520 entries.
